summary: Sysco filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement offering 12,345,679 common shares at $81.00, raising roughly $1.0bn ($970m net) to help fund its pending cash-and-stock acquisition of Jetro Restaurant Depot (JRD and Warehouse Realty) under a March 30, 2026 merger agreement. The deal creates Sysco Holdings as the new NYSE-listed parent, with Sysco and Jetro holders becoming its shareholders. The offering is not contingent on deal close; absent closing, proceeds go to general corporate purposes. Watch closing conditions, regulatory timing, overallotment exercise and deal-break risk.
